notes.title: Ver. 1.1.5
notes.content:
OK IM SO SORRY FOR THE BROKEN MOVEMENT

[h3]Fixes and changes:[/h3]

[b][list]
[*] Fixed all of the movement bugs (that were found)
[*] Dash animation is now active underwater (wasn't a bug, just a change)
[*] Increased the interval between afterimages in the Level Editor (for performance)
[/list][/b]
[h3]Side note:[/h3]

The slightly different movement won't affect beginner/casual players, however the muscle memory is slightly different for advanced players. 

Sorry about that, there was no other way...

notes.title: Ver. 1.1
notes.content:
This update, although random, did add some new things, so pay attention!

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the tutorial, now every time you beat it, the game will take you to level 1
[*] Added Gravity Flipping platforms in the level editor
[*] Removed controller vibration for wall clinging
[/list]

That's it haha watch this video

notes.title: Ver. 1.0.9
notes.content:
Reasonably important update, so stay with me here.

[list]
[*] Removed the opening cutscene's custom name (sorry)
[*] Made the first playthrough of the tutorial take you to level one after beating it
[*] Added functionality for changing Feverish Knight's sprite (Instructions below)
[/list]

[b]To change Feverish Knight's Sprite, add a PNG to AppData/LocalLow/1actose/Knight And Mourning/ and name it "Feverish-Knight.png".[/b]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1079079920434679928/1152027718536405022/image.png[/img]

[i](to return the old sprite, just delete/rename the current image in its place and the game will re-install it for you.)[/i]
[i][b]
Thanks for playing![/b][/i]
